operation_details.item: The user's Client A runs its finance systems on SAP.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I’m updating the system landscape notes before the next review. Client A runs its finance systems on SAP.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. I’ll keep that as the current record for Client A.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Thanks. Also, Client B runs its finance systems on Oracle.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: And Client C runs its finance systems on NetSuite.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: One thing I want to make sure we track consistently: System details are recorded in the client profiles.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good. I’ll rely on the client profiles for system details going forward.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Can you pull together a quick comparison of the finance platforms for our operations review?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sure. I’ll compare the three systems based on what’s recorded in the profiles — SAP for Client A, Oracle for Client B, and NetSuite for Client C.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, and keep it focused on operational impact rather than a generic ERP matrix.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. I’ll focus on operational impact and note any risks from the system differences.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: We’ll use this for the partner review on Wednesday.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds good. I’ll have the comparison ready before then.
